preliminaries.stdout:
DESCRIPTION
  OpenCode command line interface

USAGE
  opencode <subcommand> [flags] [<directory>]

ARGUMENTS
  directory string    Directory to start OpenCode in (optional)

FLAGS
  --standalone            Run with a private server instead of the background service
  --server string         Connect to a server URL instead of the background service
  --auto                  Auto-approve permissions that are not explicitly denied
  --continue, -c          Continue the last session
  --session, -s string    Session ID to continue, or to create if it does not exist
  --prompt string         Prompt to use

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|sh>                                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, sh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --print-logs                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)

SUBCOMMANDS
  upgrade, update    Upgrade OpenCode to the latest or a specific version
  uninstall          Uninstall OpenCode, keeping session data, configuration, and state
  acp                Start an Agent Client Protocol server
  api                Make a request to the running server
  debug              Debugging and troubleshooting tools
  auth               manage integrations and credentials
  mcp                Manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
  plugin             Manage plugins
  models             List all available models
  stats              Show shareable usage statistics
  mini               Start the minimal interactive interface
  run                Run OpenCode with a message
  session            Manage sessions
  service            Manage the background server
  reload             Reload configuration
  pair               Print one-time links to connect a browser or app
  serve              Start the v2 API and web server

DESCRIPTION
  Manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers

USAGE
  opencode mcp <subcommand> [flags]

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|sh>                                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, sh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --print-logs                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)

SUBCOMMANDS
  list      List configured MCP servers and their status
  add       Add an MCP server to your configuration
  auth      Authenticate with an OAuth-capable remote MCP server
  logout    Remove stored OAuth credentials for an MCP server

DESCRIPTION
  Debugging and troubleshooting tools

USAGE
  opencode debug <subcommand> [flags]

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|sh>                                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, sh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --print-logs                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)

SUBCOMMANDS
  agents       List all agents
  config       List configuration sources
  heap-dump    Write a heap snapshot of the running server and print its path
  paths        Show global paths (data, config, cache, state)

verdicts.readMeans: mcp: the server appears in `opencode mcp list` after `reload`; other families: the key survives in the `info` that `opencode debug config` reports for the file (OpenCode normalizes what it reads); a dropped key is recorded as not read

claims: V2 groups servers under mcp.servers; V2 does not place server names directly under mcp
the V1 config format remains supported; V1 and V2 fields may coexist at the top level
V2 replaces the plugin array with plugins and the permission map with an ordered permissions array

limits: one OpenCode build on one macOS machine; another build may read other shapes
read means listed or normalized by local subcommands; no session, model call or MCP tool call
the probe servers run /usr/bin/true, so `mcp list` reports them as failed: listed, not connected
plugins are local relative paths that do not exist; no plugin code was loaded
OpenCode watches parent directories of its working directory and /Library/Application Support; a system-managed configuration there, if any, could influence the result
OpenCode's own network attempts are recorded from its temporary log and were refused by the sandbox
